Name: Customisable Empty Spouse Rooms with NPC furniture
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Makes the vanilla spouse rooms into empty rooms and gives you the ability to change wallpaper and furniture placement
Description:
_Description_

*   Makes the spouse room empty so you can put your own furniture

*   It's possible to change the wallpaper, see config guide

*   I've also made "NPC furniture" packs so you can get the original NPC furniture in the game and move it around. The furniture gets delivered by mail after your wedding. You can also buy them in shops.

*   If you like this check out my other mods! I also do commissions and have a [Kofi](https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart) and you can follow my mod updates on [twitter](https://twitter.com/AsteriskArt555)﻿
_Quick Start_

1.  Download and extract this mod and it's requirements into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [this guide](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started)﻿).

2.  It's ready to play

3.  See the config guide in order to change the wallpaper and floors
_Config guide_
Wall art:

*   The original wall art is kept by default

*   If you want the want the walls to be empty set the config for wall_art to 'false'

*   If you don't want the vanilla wall art and have another mod that retextures the wall art you can either delete the "Assets\townInterior.png" in this mod, or replace it with the "townInterior" image from the other mod instead
Wallpaper and flooring:

*   You __can__ change the spouse room wallpaper, but using the config.json rather than applying wallpaper items in-game. 

*   If you use [GMCM](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) you can make changes while you are playing by switching between different images

*   The config is designed to use the image with a filename that matches whatever you type as your wallpaper config, so if you go into the "CE Spouse Rooms\[CP] Walls and Floors Changes\Assets" folder and, for example, copy the name "**aster custom**" and type it into the field for **WallFloor_Filename** and save your config, the walls and floors will change to whatever was on the image.

*   The spouseroom wallpaper and flooring have been added to the wallpaper [catalogue ](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Catalogue)﻿so you can use it in the rest of your house.
Other configs:

*   You can choose to keep Sebastian's original frog sanctuary, or just use the furniture version included in the mod
_Tips and Tricks
_

*   You can edit the images in "[CP] Walls and Floors" with designs you like. There's a picture of each NPC next to their wallpaper and flooring so it's easy to see who's room you are changing.

*   Some of the furniture, like the computer desk, have more than one rotation.

*   The furniture and map components of this mod can be used separately. So, for example, you could delete the "Furniture" folder because you prefer to use [Alternative Textures Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13064) instead of DGA, but still keep the map and wall changes.﻿

*   Furniture can be found in the furniture catalogue, but not CJB item spawner.

*   If you don't want to see DGA furniture listed in shops, delete the "shops.json" in the DGA folder.
_Compatibility_

*   Won't affect custom NPC spouse rooms, but can still be used while marrying custom NPCs

*   Works with Free Love and Custom Spouse Rooms

*   Works with recolors if you delete the delete the "Assets\townInterior.png" in this mod

*   Works with custom farmhouses, though if they already make the spouseroom empty you can remove the "map changes" portion of this mod
_To uninstall:_

*   If you're only using the map changes you can basically just delete the mod. If you're also using the furniture you should remove it in-game before deleting the mod
_Recommended mods_

*   [NPC furniture and wallpaper](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13064), which merges content from ﻿[Krobus NPC furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11043)﻿ and [yellow furniture recolors](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10327) into one big pack

*   [vanilla style furniture reccomendations](https://stardewmodding.miraheze.org/wiki/Vanilla_Style_Furniture)
